title: Lease Renewal & Tenant Churn Prediction

blueprintSignals.name: Renewal rent gap
blueprintSignals.definition: proposed renewal rent minus the market rent for a similar unit
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Market rent estimates are noisy, so use a range

blueprintSignals.name: Maintenance resolution time
blueprintSignals.definition: median days to close a request in the last 12 months
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Logging gaps understate delays, so use ticket close dates

blueprintSignals.name: Tenure
blueprintSignals.definition: months in the unit, bucketed into cohorts
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Strongly tied to age and life stage, so check for unfairness

blueprintSignals.name: Life events
blueprintSignals.definition: moves in the job address, a change in household size or an inquiry about a purchase
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Data are partial and consent-based, so use only data the tenant has agreed to share

label: For "Lease Renewal & Tenant Churn Prediction": Predict which tenants will renew so managers can set renewal offers that keep good tenants without leaving rent on the table. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Past offers were not random, so renewals reflect the offer chosen and not the tenant.
